prompt.generated_prompt_string: Retro dressing-room vanity with cluttered cosmetics, a red rose, a yellow ashtray, chrome hubcap wall decor, and pink XOXO writing on the mirror, high-fashion editorial photoshoot. A clearly adult glamorous woman sits on a high red leather bar stool, one leg extended forward resting on the vanity counter with a red high-heel shoe, the other leg bent and dangling, holding a red satin ribbon between both hands and leaning back slightly with a confident direct gaze at camera. She has long blonde wavy hair with a small hair clip, bold dramatic eye makeup, glossy red lips, realistic skin texture with natural pores, and wears a very short shiny red satin strapless mini dress with a subtle ruffle or peplum edge, red high heels with ankle-strap detail, and a large gold bracelet. Use warm practical vanity bulbs mixed with ambient room light, natural-looking skin highlights, realistic glossy sheen on satin and heels, soft but defined shadows, believable light falloff, subtle lens flare and micro-contrast. Capture it like a real behind-the-scenes iPhone 17 Pro Max main-camera photograph, 24mm equivalent at approximately f/1.78, medium-full body, natural shallow depth of field, ultra-photorealistic but not airbrushed, authentic skin texture, dominant red color scheme, and glamorous retro fashion direction. Keep the pose playful and non-sexual; use replaceable generic mirror lettering rather than a person's name or unverified brand text.
